title: Kazakhstan Bank Uses Hong Kong as Gateway for Offshore RMB Finance
detail: Kazakhstan's bank has turned to Hong Kong as a gateway for offshore renminbi (CNH) financing, signaling continued expansion of RMB internationalization through the territory. The move reflects growing Central Asian interest in yuan-denominated financial instruments and Hong Kong's deepening role as the global hub for offshore renminbi transactions, advancing Beijing's long-term goal of reducing dollar dependence in trade and investment flows.

title: Taiwan: Sovereignty 'Cannot Be Violated' After China Ends Coast Guard Patrol
detail: Taiwan asserted that its sovereignty 'cannot be violated' following China's conclusion of a coast guard patrol around the island. The patrol, conducted by China's coast guard vessels, drew a firm rebuttal from Taipei, which reiterated its position on self-governance and territorial integrity. The incident underscores ongoing tensions in the Taiwan Strait as Beijing continues to assert jurisdiction over Taiwan's surrounding waters through regular patrol operations.

media.caption: Taiwan rejects China's coast guard patrol, asserting sovereignty cannot be violated
